card.name: Inside rare names with T or Q
card.fires_on: Letters like q, Q, ov, ova, DI or UL partway through unusual names or acronyms, especially after a T. Most often in the suffix of atezolizumab and hyaluronidase-tqjs and in tovorafenib.

modes.label: Drug-name endings
modes.description: The q in the hyaluronidase-tqjs suffix, or the Q in VOQ-type brand names such as RINVOQ.
modes.example: dosage of ZEPZELCA in combination with atezolizumab or atezolizumab and hyaluronidase-t<<q>>js is 3.2 mg/m

modes.label: Start of T-names
modes.description: The piece right after a capital T in tovorafenib, Tova and acronyms such as TDI.
modes.example: Management Avoid coadministration of OJEMDA with a strong or moderate CYP2C8 inducer. Mechanism and Clinical Effect(s) T<<ov>>orafenib is a CYP2

modes.label: Acronyms and foreign names
modes.description: Middle letters of acronyms like WTUL or of transliterated names like Tawqi'.
